title: Berita Swipe
summary: An AI-personalised news swipe prototype: no endless scrolling, just the five most relevant stories of the day.
overview: An AI-personalised news swipe prototype for Astro AWANI. It uses the OpenAI API to tag articles and generate questions, then personalises each reader's stories from their answers to mood-based questions, what is happening that day, and how they interact during the session.
problem: News overload — readers face endless scrolling instead of a short list of stories that matter to them.
features: AI article tagging and categorisation with the OpenAI API
AI-generated, mood-based questions to personalise the feed
Recommendations from session-based reader signals and the day's news
Editorial dashboard tracking readers, swipes and article opens

features: Interactive city map of the six largest ministry allocations
Buildings light up to match the benefits in your result

title: Teringat — WhatsApp Automation & Reminder Dashboard
summary: “WhatsApp je. Biar Teringat uruskan.” Send it on WhatsApp and Teringat keeps track: reminders, project ideas and saved links in one dashboard.
overview: Teringat turns WhatsApp messages into an organised dashboard. It groups what you send into today's reminders, upcoming reminders by date and time, project ideas, saved links tagged by source, and a recently-added feed.
features: Today and upcoming reminders with date and time
Saved links tagged by source (e.g. Threads)

title: WhatsApp Hermes AI Personal Assistant
summary: An AI personal assistant that lives in WhatsApp and runs scheduled jobs, like a daily brief of trending Shopee products with ready-to-post Threads captions.
overview: Hermes is an AI personal assistant integrated with WhatsApp. Besides answering in chat, it runs scheduled cron jobs that message results back. One daily job picks five trending kitchen and home products on Shopee Malaysia under RM30, explains why each one is interesting, and drafts a Threads caption for each.
features: Lives inside WhatsApp — no separate app
Scheduled cron jobs that report back in chat
Daily Shopee product brief: price, why it's interesting, and a Threads caption
confidential: Private messages and contact data are never shown in this portfolio.
